name: Holiday Mixer
source:
It's nearing the holidays and you find yourself with less plans that usual to fill your end of year schedule, as friends are out of town and most of your family is delayed in travels. Being in a season of giving, your bestie is at least appreciative to have you around to cover her shift for one day before she is back from vacation. Serve customers as a barista at the Brewspout -- filling in on one of the busiest days of the year, the Holiday Mixer special. Create a unique drink combo order based on what you think the person might enjoy and need this time of year. Depending on what you brew, your success might open some future holiday plan possibilities! 

[From [url=https://kipursuit.itch.io/holiday-mixer]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
假期临近，你发现自己的年终计划比平常少了，因为朋友出城了，而你的大多数家人都因旅行而延误。在一个奉献的季节，你的闺蜜至少会很感激在她度假回来之前有你在她身边替她值班一天。在Brewspout担任咖啡师为顾客提供服务——在一年中最繁忙的日子之一——假日调酒师特餐中填补空白。根据你认为此人一年中这个时候可能喜欢和需要的饮料，创建独特的饮料组合订单。根据你酿造的饮料，你的成功可能会为未来的假期计划带来一些可能性！

[来自[url=https://kipursuit.itch.io/holiday-mixer]itch.io[/url]]
